name: Steepy · Gremlet #31
description:
A mint wyrm small enough to nap in a teacup, so it does. Smells faintly of jasmine.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Steepy in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
